purpose: Shirt-only layers over the unchanged original Roomie sprites

prompts.front:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent front-facing clothing replacement sprite layer for MashRoom's existing 2D Roomie. Image 1 is the original character used ONLY as exact fit/painting-style reference. Image 2 is the customer's garment-design reference.
Create ONLY the white/off-white cotton MashRoom short-sleeve crewneck tee from Image 2 fitted to Image 1's squat chibi torso, with the small green mascot/red question-mark/yellow spark chest print on the wearer's left chest (viewer right). Keep the rounded shoulder slope and neutral front stance of Image 1; the shirt must fully cover the original charcoal top and tall collar. Slightly loose sleeves and softly stitched hem, painterly illustration matching Image 1, not a photoreal product shot. The worn shape should be wide and short: approx width 470 to height 340, NOT the long adult-sized proportions of the garment reference.
Include just a tiny matching peach neck-fill inside/above the crewneck opening so this layer conceals the old dark high-neck collar; do NOT include a head, face, hair, glasses, shoulders/arms skin, hands, pants, legs or shoes. Shirt and little neck fill ONLY. Tight clean alpha cutout, centered with a small transparent margin. Actual transparent background. No ground, no shadow outside garment, no UI, no labels, no reference-sheet text, no hanger, no mannequin. Preserve the supplied garment print and soft ivory fabric; no old collar emblem. This is a composited garment layer, not a replacement character.
prompts.left:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent LEFT-facing clothing replacement sprite layer for an existing 2D character. Image 1 is the exact original LEFT-facing character used as torso-fit and painterly style reference, NOT an edit target to reproduce whole. Image 2 is the approved FRONT shirt-only layer to match material, neckline, logo and brushwork. Image 3 is the customer's tee reference sheet.
Draw ONLY this same soft ivory/white MashRoom crewneck cotton tee as worn on Image 1's left-facing torso. Match the profile shoulders and slightly diagonal chest/waist orientation exactly, loose short sleeve over the near upper arm, softly stitched hem and sleeve. Fit proportions approx 290 wide by 325 tall with the same neutral walking shoulder pose. Replace the old dark high collar with a crewneck: include only a small matching peach neck-fill inside the opening to cover the old collar when composited. The chest print is on the front of the tee: only a small perspectively compressed glimpse may be visible at the forward/LEFT chest edge, never on the back, never a big side decal.
Shirt plus tiny neck-fill ONLY. No face, hair, glasses, head, hands, bare arms, trousers, legs, shoes, mannequin or hanger. Do not depict a full character. Actual transparent background and transparent space around garment. Painterly 2D texture matching the original Roomie, not a photo. No floor, background, outside drop shadow, labels, text, UI or old collar emblem. Center this standalone clothing layer with small transparent margins.
prompts.right:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent RIGHT-facing clothing replacement sprite layer for an existing 2D character. Image 1 is the exact original RIGHT-facing Roomie used as torso-fit and painterly style reference. Image 2 is the approved white FRONT tee layer. Image 3 is the garment reference.
Draw ONLY this same soft ivory/white MashRoom short-sleeve cotton crewneck tee fitted to Image 1's right-facing torso. The front of the chest points RIGHT; the near sleeve is on the LEFT half of this image. Preserve the exact shoulder slope and chest-to-waist orientation of Image 1's existing shirt, gently loose fit, softly stitched sleeve and hem. Approx layer aspect 290 wide to 325 high. Include only a tiny peach neck-fill at the collar opening to cover the original high dark collar on compositing.
The mascot print sits on the wearer's LEFT FRONT chest. In this RIGHT-side view that print is hidden on the far front plane; NO logo on the visible near sleeve or back. This view is plain white like the customer's right-side tee view. Match the texture and seam language of Image 2.
Only the garment and tiny neck-fill. No face, hair, head, glasses, bare arms, hands, pants, legs, shoes, hanger, mannequin or full character. Genuine clean alpha transparency outside its silhouette, small transparent margin, no exterior glow/haze/drop-shadow/ground. No UI, labels, writing, watermark or old collar emblem.
